context.body: Bones, descendants, and later memory · Hebrews 11:20–22
context.label: Bones, descendants, and later memory

observations.body: The sequence joins Isaac’s blessing, Jacob’s blessing of Joseph’s sons, and Joseph’s final instructions about the exodus and his remains.
observations.label: Joseph speaks by faith about departure and bones

observations.body: The passage presents Jacob blesses Joseph’s sons and Joseph mentions the departure as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Jacob blesses Joseph’s sons and Joseph mentions the departure

observations.body: The passage places The departure and bone instruction are characterized as faith beside Jacob blesses Joseph’s sons and Joseph mentions the departure.
observations.label: The departure and bone instruction are characterized as faith

payload.posture: Read Hebrews 11:20–22 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the sequence joins Isaac’s blessing, Jacob’s blessing of Joseph’s sons, and Joseph’s final instructions about the exodus and his remains. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: Joseph speaks by faith about departure and bones
